key_insight: AMM allocates a fixed evaluation budget across classical optimizers using online landscape probes, achieving the highest target share in 382 of 600 held-out BBOB test cells, including ties.
engineering_relevance: For continuous black-box engineering problems, AMM offers an open-source Python optimizer that adapts solver choice to landscape structure while charging probe costs to the evaluation budget.
method: Probe curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure online.
Route evaluations among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy engines.
Give each probe a default and a dimension-by-budget validity range.
evidence_signal: A one-time held-out BBOB evaluation covered instances 101–110, dimensions 2–40 and budgets of 10D–1000D: AMM led outright in 236 of 600 cells, tied for the lead in 146 and was credibly behind in 35 under a descriptive posterior rule.
watch_item: Advantages were less reliable at tight budgets and under rotated separable landscapes; on held-out MA-BBOB at 2000D, final target share matched IPOP-CMA-ES while anytime area was lower.
paper_title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
